verdicts.reason: A is just the square layout shrunk and centred: wide dead bands left and right, a tiny unreadable attribution and logo, and the circle drifting into the area beside the quote, so it doesn't suit the banner format. B rearranges into a proper two-column banner with large readable quote text and the can and circle as a strong right-hand focal point; its flaws are a big gap between the quote mark and the quote, the text block sitting close to the bottom edge, and the logo moved inside the circle under the can.
